description: Grid-first proxy pipeline using 500m cells, 2024 classified POI extracts, and H3 aggregation.

source_provenance.role: Sale-price and subway-distance proxy for affordability and access context.
source_provenance.collection_date: Provided with project files on 2026-05-24; original scrape date not encoded in the file name.

source_provenance.role: Primary baseline and Track A amenity layer.
source_provenance.collection_date: Archive provided on 2026-05-24; POI update_time values in sampled files are mainly 2024 records.
source_provenance.processing_note: Uses bigType, midType, and smallType filters documented in poi_2024_mapping_notes.md.

source_provenance.role: Walk/bike edge availability and nearest-amenity network access cache.
source_provenance.collection_date: Provided with project files on 2026-05-24; original extraction date not encoded in the file name.
source_provenance.processing_note: Uses foot and bicycle flags plus graph edges for sparse Dijkstra accessibility.

source_provenance.role: Shanghai clipping boundary and 500 m grid extent.
source_provenance.collection_date: Fetched or refreshed during local pipeline execution.
source_provenance.processing_note: Cached locally at data/raw/shanghai_boundary_310000.json for reproducibility.

source_provenance.source: Cached AQI and Sentinel-2 NDVI proxy layers
source_provenance.role: Track A environmental quality and greenery inputs.
source_provenance.collection_date: Cached locally during the 2026-05-24 prototype build.
source_provenance.processing_note: Attached as district / sampled proxy surfaces, not as high-resolution per-pixel remote-sensing analysis.

method_summary: Clip Shanghai municipal boundary, project to EPSG:4576, and build a 500 m grid.
Classify 2024 POIs with type fields rather than noisy keyword-only name matching.
Attach housing sale-price proxy, subway-distance proxy, road metrics, environmental proxies, and POI counts to grid / H3 layers.
Compute mode-specific 15-minute radius proxy surfaces using documented speed assumptions.
Improve walk and bike with sparse road-network nearest-amenity access; keep transit and car as documented proxies.
Aggregate cell metrics to H3 r8 for web visualization and recommendation ranking.

score_method.normalization: Most count / length fields are clipped at the 95th percentile and scaled to 0-1 before scoring.
score_method.baseline: Universal needs layer combines schools, healthcare, groceries, convenience, parks, transit, walk/bike support, and housing context.
score_method.track: Track A adds fitness, sport/open-space, fresh-market/healthy-food, greenery, and AQI proxy indicators.
score_method.walk_bike_network_blend: Walk/bike baseline scores are blended with 35% road-network nearest-amenity access; Track A walk/bike scores use 40% network track access.
score_method.housing_missingness: H3 cells without housing samples are flagged and receive no affordability credit.

track_indicator_status.gym_or_fitness_studio: Implemented from 2024 POI fitness center category.
track_indicator_status.public_park_with_exercise_equipment: Partially implemented as public park proxy; exercise-equipment tags are not separately available.
track_indicator_status.running_track_sports_field_basketball: Partially implemented through basketball and sport POI categories.
track_indicator_status.public_swimming_pool: Implemented from swimming POI category where present.
track_indicator_status.yoga_martial_arts_dance: Partially represented inside broader fitness / sport POI categories.
track_indicator_status.dedicated_cycling_lane_length: Approximated with simplified road bicycle availability, not audited protected lane data.
track_indicator_status.fresh_market_health_food: Implemented with grocery, market, supermarket, and fresh-food POI proxies.
track_indicator_status.ndvi: Implemented as cached Sentinel-2 NDVI proxy surface.
track_indicator_status.aqi: Implemented as cached AQI proxy surface.

limitations: Scores are still proxy indicators, not full network isochrone results from routing engines.
The current app uses sale-price data as an affordability proxy instead of true rent listings.
Transit mode currently uses stop density and subway proximity, not GTFS timetables or service frequency.
Walk and bike scores include local road-network nearest-amenity access, but they are still not full polygonal isochrones from a routing API.
Transit and car scores remain neighborhood accessibility proxies rather than exact per-cell 15-minute path searches.
